fields.label: Event
fields.options:
Heart attack (myocardial infarction)
Stroke
TIA (transient ischaemic attack)
Angioplasty or stent
Bypass surgery (CABG)
Other major heart or brain event
Paralysis or weakness, not yet clarified

fields.label: How it is known
fields.options:
Documented (medical record or discharge summary)
Reported by caregiver or family
fields.description: Written records are not required (DRL A8). Leave blank until known: an event without a source stays pending.

fields.label: When
fields.options:
Happening now
Recent, symptoms resolved
Past history
fields.description: Happening now is an emergency: tick the red-flag symptom and follow the emergency pathway.

fields.label: TIA diagnosis
fields.options:
Clinically diagnosed
Transient symptoms, not verified
fields.description: A clinically diagnosed TIA counts towards Level 4 (an addition to DRL A8, pending rule validation). Transient symptoms that no doctor has diagnosed stay pending.

fields.label: If the date is approximate
fields.description: For example: early 2024, or about 3 years ago.

fields.label: Discharge Status
fields.options:
Still in hospital
Discharged home
Discharged to rehabilitation or a care facility
Not known

fields.label: Rehabilitation needs, where known
fields.description: For example physiotherapy, speech or occupational therapy. No disability grading is asked for.
